title: Motion (Jurado - Soto-Martinez) relative to instructing the Department of City Planning in consultation with the Department of Transportation, Bureau of…
text:
[Council File 26-0756]
Motion (Jurado - Soto-Martinez) relative to instructing the Department of City Planning in consultation with the Department of Transportation, Bureau of Street Services, Bureau of Engineering, the Department of Building and Safety, City Attorney, and State of California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control, to report with the following: 1) an analysis and report on SB 969 (Wiener), including its requirements, limitations, and potential regulatory controls regarding Entertainment Zones; 2) recommendations for establishing one or more Entertainment Zones in Downtown Los Angeles, consistent with the provisions of SB 969; 3) conduct necessary public hearings with Council District 14 stakeholders, small businesses, hospitality specialists, cultural organizations, Business Improvement Districts, and Neighborhood Councils, to shape the Entertainment Zone program, to incorporate their feedback into the requested report and recommendations.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
